summary: This bill requires states to disregard income earned during the first year of a registered apprenticeship when determining eligibility for Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) benefits, with a penalty for states that fail to do so.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Social Security Act to require states to disregard income from the first year of an apprenticeship when determining eligibility for Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF). This change would expand access to welfare benefits for individuals in apprenticeships, thus expanding the social safety net.
